bio: The FamilySearch tree identifies the husband of Keturah Pringle as Charles Carter Robins/Robbins, born 30 Sep 1829 in Greenwich Twp., Gloucester Co., New Jersey, son of John Robbins (1803-1886) and Sarah Carter (1800-1886), who died 23 Sep 1878 in Hanover Twp., Luzerne Co., and is buried in Hanover Cemetery ([R4-S2]). The tree lists their children as Emily (1855-1930), Ella (1859-1919), Lulu M. (1862-1950), Byron S. (1870-1951) and Clarence Howard (1873-1959). Lulu M. matches Bradsby's 'Lulu M., daughter of Charles and Keturah (Pringle) Robbins', who married Plymouth tax collector Charles W. Honeywell on 28 Feb 1883 ([R4-S1]). The widowed Keturah married Philip Manhart on 19 Sep 1883 ([R4-S2]).
